gauge_fix: Airspeed exponent is fixed to +1 because a global monotone power/scale gauge otherwise makes the exponent vector non-identifiable. Family-specific constant scale is explicitly not claimed identifiable.
airspeed_reconstruction_note: UIUC dynamic files report J rather than raw airspeed. Development reconstructs V_a algebraically as J*(RPM/60)*D. Therefore this stage validates raw-variable coordinate form after algebraic reconstruction, not sensor-level discovery.
objective: For each propeller family, compare dynamic CT and CP curves across distinct RPM runs in candidate z_b using interpolation on common support. Family score is median pair NRMSE. Selection minimizes median sqrt(CT_score*CP_score) across training families.
interpretation_before_external_test: The identifiable within-family coordinate class is approximately V_a/RPM^1.12, reproducing v0.14's correction without supplying J to the search. This is only development evidence until independently replicated.
